detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

A priority matrix that drops nothing is just a prettier to-do list.

Put each task on today's list in one box: urgent and important (do it today), important only (give it a time), urgent only (hand off or shrink it), neither (delete it).

One rule before you start: cross out at least one task. If the last box is empty, you sorted too kindly.

#productivity
